ModMetaData.name: Harmony 3 Strict Binding Compat (local)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Local stop-gap fixes for RimWorld 1.7 (Harmony 3, UnityStubs). Remove each one when the mod it covers is fixed. Same list as the README on GitHub. Every C# fix fingerprints the method it touches and logs a red error when that mod updates; XML fixes fail loudly the same way. - Biomes! Caverns (Caveworld Flora): wild fungus colonies regrow (each removed mushroom lowers its colony's count; on load counts are reset to the live mushrooms). - Biomes! Caverns (Caveworld Flora): wild fungi mouseover shows growth again instead of "Brightbells)". - Biomes! Caverns: strips the equipment nodes from BMT_ResourceBlueCrystal ("is equipment but has no verbs or tools"). - Loading Progress: its startup profiler no longer races during parallel XML loading (a mod's defs could fail to load and crash the game into a ModsConfig reset). - Loadout Compositing + Better Workbench Management: per-tag bills get the "count pawns away / on caravan" option back (BWM's new Debug build broke LC's transpiler). - Better Workbench Management: its bill options no longer overlap the "Use global style" dropdown (vanilla classic mode or Style Change Anytime). - Better Workbench Management (personal tweak): previous/next bill arrows drawn 7 px higher, clear of the ingredient filter. - Busywork + LTO Colony Groups: "Upper" job icons show on Colony Groups portraits (Busywork only hooked the vanilla colonist bar). - Sensible Bed Ownership: OwnedBed answers cached per pawn until bed ownership changes (was rescanning every bed hundreds of thousands of times a minute); spot-checked against SBO; also used by the parallel render threads, and SBO's bed list scan is locked (sleeping animals in animal beds halved FPS, render jobs threw "Collection was modified"). - Hauler's Dream + Compositable Loadouts: loadout items are kept during surplus unload again (CL's items now list several defs; HD only knew Item.Def). - Hauler's Dream + Kanban Stockpile Continue: HD respects Kanban's max stack size when it plans pick-ups and unloads into capped storage (no more overfill / remove-excess churn). - Common Sense: no "random element from empty collection" warnings for food no recipe makes (meal ingredients lookup skipped). - Common Sense: clean-before-eating moves on when its filth is already gone instead of erroring out of the eating job. - Prisoner Realism + Cleaning Area Relaunched: prisoners only clean filth inside the Clean area, no more standing-still Clean job loop. - Hunt For Me: only player animals take hunting jobs (a released animal marked for hunting no longer hunts itself). - Designator Shapes + Better Architect Menu: flood fill stops at doors again. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: the telescope pose mirrors with the telescope's art, so a West-rotated telescope is used from the eyepiece side too. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: in the telescope pose the telescope is drawn over the pawn and under its hands. - VFE Tribals + UI Rethemed - Factions (visual tweak): the Cornerstones button is drawn as a UI Rethemed button in the themed Factions title bar. - Show Mod Updates + UI Rethemed - Main Bar (visual tweak): the "N updated mods" menu button gets an icon. - UI Rethemed - Notifications (visual tweak): the top-left messages are drawn as rows in its bottom-right notification stack, live 30 s, and a hovered one stays. - UI Rethemed - Colonist Card: the activity row no longer blanks on job changes (an empty row is filled from the live job line and the stale duplicate dropped; multi-line reports use their first line). - UI Rethemed - Colonist Card (visual tweak): with needs and skills at a glance, the Card Height slider is a minimum, so the card stops jumping when a "Carrying" row comes and goes. - Auto-Cast Specialist Commands + Det's Xenotypes - Stoneborn (personal tweak): Stonecall is auto-cast when mining or finishing construction, following the Auto-Cast Mining Command setting, which right-click on the Stonecall gizmo toggles (check icon shown). - Vanilla (found through Modern Needs Tab): an emptied minified thing has a label again, so job reports no longer throw and MNT keeps recording job history. - Stem's VWE Industrial Expansion, Fortification Industrial - Citadel: missing weapon sounds pointed at existing ones (pistol equip, sawn-off repeater shot, flame bunker). - Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage: animalfeeders (strigoi) drink animal hemogen packs on their own, like regular packs, when no prisoner or regular pack is available. - Hospitality: Vending machines (personal tweak): the powered vending machine draws 100 W and keeps stored items frozen while powered. - Mod Settings Framework (VEF): slider settings reach every def their xpath matches, not just the first (ReBuild's grate speed slider now covers the sterile grate tile). - MSS Tweaks and Fun: haunt portraits no longer saved upside down on 1.7/Vulkan. - MSS Tweaks and Fun: VFE Pirates Buckoneer culture patch remapped to the VFEP_Mercenaries faction. - Eternal Pawns: faction leaders, leader kinds and warcasket wearers stay out of the veteran draw; MustBeCapableOfViolence honoured. - Eternal Pawns: an issued veteran leaves the world pawn list, so vanilla cannot redress it a second time in the same group (duplicate caravan pawns, stuck trade caravans). - Hospitality: Casino: tables given Casino's vending comp by LocalTweaks (tongo, billiards) charge visitors once per game. - Hospitality: Casino: the inspect pane shows the pricing setting and the silver charged per game. - Hospitality: Casino: only casino visitors and trade caravans at their chill spot play slot machines (bestowers, shuttle guards and leaving caravans keep their duty). - Hospitality: visitors in warcaskets skip the arrival re-gear (casket pieces re-locked) and keep their casket helmet on. - Hospitality: diagnostic only, logs which think node puts a guest with a claimed bed on the floor. - Giddy-Up 2: dismounted caravan animals keep their travel/follow target, so the caravan arrives and leaves. - Vanilla/unknown: a caravan guard holding a trader kind counts as the Trader (dismiss works, caravan exits). - RimPacts: factions whose exiled leader left or was dismissed get a new leader (also repaired after load), no more "Faction leader for X is null". - VEF (MVCF): multi-verb weapons use the weapon's own accuracy/cooldown when the verb sets none; duplicate stat rows hidden; Range row fixed. - VEF: verb range factor applied to the result instead of the shared verb def (no stuck ranges). - Simple Leadership: leaders only join raids whose points cover them. - Sensible Bed Ownership: reservation prefix skipped for beds with no map. - Skilled Refueling: Harmony 3 unchecked binding for its mistyped __instance patch. - Basic Traits: "TraitHediffApplier: Processing pawn" debug spam removed. - Triumphant Research: shows the full unlock list instead of a blank window. - Too Many Mods: 22 lowercase "Defs/thingDef[" xpaths fixed (Rimsenal items). - Rimsenal Faction Pack - Spacer: no second style comp on the mech commander helmet, Dresser, EndTable and FloodLight. - ReGrowth plant patches: duplicate wild plant records removed from biomes (world-gen Landmarks/Mutators steps). - Vanilla: no needs while no world exists (quest pawns built before the world loads). - Vanilla/unknown: trade ship slave also saved as a world pawn no longer loads twice. - Vanilla (personal tweak): install and implant-removal operations get the implant item as their menu icon instead of a grey square.
